Wind Quirk.name: Wind Quirk
Wind Quirk.description:
🌪️ You make wind and drive it where you aim.

🌱 At the start your gusts knock an adult off their feet about ten meters away, an updraft lifts you a story high, and you clear the smoke from a room.
📈 With training: cutting air edges, wind walls that turn thrown objects aside, true flight carrying others, smoke-pulling drafts, cyclones, a whole crowd flown to safety.
⚠️ Wind feeds fires and throws debris, so check what lies behind your target.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as strong wind stops going where you aim it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Inasa Yoarashi (Whirlwind).

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Gust Shove, Updraft Bound
Wind Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user makes moving air and throws it from the hands (or whole body, player's choice). A new adult user's gust knocks an adult off their feet about ten meters away; an updraft lifts the user a story high or slows a fall; a draft clears a room of smoke in seconds. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: wind moves everything in its path, so debris, glass and bystanders go with the target; it fans flames and pushes smoke and gas downwind. Braced or heavy targets hold; a sealed room only churns. At the start it cannot cut, keep anyone aloft past a moment, or pin anyone. Quirk Strain: light: gust, updraft hop; moderate: cutting edge, wind wall, flight; heavy: pulling smoke from a building, cyclone; severe: signature storm, flying a crowd to safety. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed public gusts are a crime; the user answers for every sign, window and pedestrian their wind throws into traffic. Look: in use, hair and clothes whip, dust spirals, air roars.
